history.summary: A freehold 2BR (775 sqft) at 46 Boon Teck Road, D12, asking $2.0M / $2,581 psf with no built year and no project transaction data. $2,581 psf for a small 2BR is very aggressive, and a 1.09km/13-min walk to Toa Payoh MRT removes any transit premium.

The freehold $2M quantum is liquid in band, but the PSF and thin data don't support a buy.
